TechnicalFAQ.q: Which telephony systems do you support?
TechnicalFAQ.a: SIP and VoIP trunks from any carrier, plus native integrations with Twilio, 3CX, Asterisk and FreePBX. If you use a hosted PBX we can usually connect via SIP registration or a forwarded number in under a day.

TechnicalFAQ.q: How many calls can it handle at once?
TechnicalFAQ.a: Concurrency is effectively unlimited — the platform scales horizontally, so a spike from three simultaneous calls to eighty does not create a queue. This is the structural advantage over headcount: peak demand stops being a staffing problem.

TechnicalFAQ.q: Can it write into our CRM and calendar?
TechnicalFAQ.a: Yes. Standard connectors exist for HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Google Calendar and Microsoft 365. Anything with a REST API can be integrated during onboarding, and we build the field mapping with you rather than handing you a form.

TechnicalFAQ.q: What happens if your service goes down?
TechnicalFAQ.a: Calls fail over to your existing routing immediately, so a caller reaches your team as they did before Agjent038 existed. Operations plans carry a 99.5% uptime target and Enterprise a contractual 99.9% SLA.

TechnicalFAQ.q: Do you use our conversations to train shared models?
TechnicalFAQ.a: No. Your data is used only to improve your own deployment, under your retention policy. Enterprise customers can run on a fully isolated instance with EU data residency guarantees written into the agreement.

TechnicalFAQ.q: Can we run it in only one part of our operation first?
TechnicalFAQ.a: That is what we recommend. Start with after-hours and overflow — the calls you are already losing. Measure containment for thirty days, then decide whether to move primary queue traffic across.

FAQs.q: Does the AI actually speak natural Albanian?
FAQs.a: Yes. Agjent038 is tuned on Kosovo Albanian, including Gheg pronunciation and the code-switching people actually use on the phone. It also handles English, Serbian, German and Turkish, and switches language mid-call when the caller does. You can hear real recorded samples on your discovery call before you commit to anything.

FAQs.q: What happens when the AI cannot handle something?
FAQs.a: It escalates. You define the rules — refund thresholds, complaint keywords, detected frustration, VIP accounts — and Agjent038 transfers the caller to the right human with a written summary already in their screen. Nothing is left in limbo, and no caller is trapped in a loop.

It replaces the queue, not the people. Most operators keep their team and redeploy them onto retention, complex cases and outbound revenue work, while Agjent038 absorbs the repetitive tier-1 volume that burns agents out and inflates cost per contact.

FAQs.q: How long does it take to go live?
FAQs.a: Two weeks from kickoff for the Reception plan. Days 1–3 are discovery and call audit, days 4–10 are build and training, days 11–14 are shadow mode where the AI answers on a test line and you approve every behaviour. Complex integrations may add a week.

FAQs.q: What does $499 per month actually include?
FAQs.a: The full product: 24/7 answering in five languages, up to 1,000 answered conversations, booking, CRM and calendar integration, transcripts, recordings, the live dashboard, warm transfer, onboarding and shadow mode. There is no setup fee and no per-minute surprise billing on the base plan.

FAQs.q: How does this compare with hiring a receptionist?
FAQs.a: One full-time agent in Kosovo covers roughly 40 hours a week and answers one call at a time. Agjent038 covers 168 hours a week, answers unlimited concurrent calls, never has a bad day, and costs less than a single salary — while producing a transcript and quality score for every conversation.

Conversations are encrypted in transit and at rest, processed on EU infrastructure, and retained only as long as your policy specifies. We sign a DPA, support GDPR data-subject requests, and Enterprise customers can run on a dedicated instance with strict residency guarantees.

FAQs.q: Can we keep our current phone number and provider?
FAQs.a: Yes. Agjent038 sits on top of your existing telephony — SIP trunks, Twilio, 3CX, Asterisk, FreePBX or your carrier. Nothing needs to be ripped out, and you can route only a percentage of traffic while you build confidence.

FAQs.q: What if it does not work for us?
FAQs.a: You see performance in shadow mode before a single customer is exposed to it, and monthly plans are month-to-month with 30 days' notice. If containment does not hit the target we agreed in discovery, we keep tuning at no extra cost or you walk away.
